description: Δ_λ residual simplex moments μ₃=+0.4708, μ₄=−4.591 tested against the DERIVED (0-fit, q₀-only) ρ_F cluster integrals. Decomposition μ_k = s_k − g_k with g_k the DERIVED graded (q-factorial) simplex coeffs (g₂=1,g₃=0.342,g₄=8.371) and s_k the AME strong-binding simplex (targets). Derived ρ_F connected 3-body cluster c₃<0 (T −1.769, ³He −1.405 MeV, H_9 joint trace); derived 4-body product-model beyond-pairwise content c₄<0. SIGN GATE: μ₃>0 ≠ c₃<0 (WALL, Lean-proved by productModel_3body_nonpos + markovParam_le_half: no pairwise interface product gives a positive 3-body cluster for any q>0); μ₄<0 sign-consistent with c₄<0 but its magnitude is dominated by the DERIVED graded g₄=+8.37 subtraction, not an ρ_F cluster. FREE PARAMS: a single N>0 cannot map same-sign (c₃,c₄) to opposite-sign (μ₃,μ₄); no 0–1-param derivation lands both moments. VERDICT: WALL (split) — scope-(b) proved sign exclusion of the pairwise-product route for μ₃; scope-(a) sign-consistent-but-not-derived for μ₄. NOT infra-gated. Nothing wired.

parameters.note: AME ρ_strong enters only as the μ_k target; ρ_F clusters use q₀ + derived factors.
